findings: ETT.tex:1344-1356, at the BTZ points of an E_{>=0}-manifold (where Section 3 uses the definition), in DEC-64's corrected form and the readings DEC-25, OQ-18, OQ-34/35, OQ-82: the two global facts that the definition gives the later proofs hold at every BTZ point of every E_{>=0}-manifold, causal or not, with no Hausdorff or countability hypothesis: the past is a BTZ half-line in the sense of SingularPastAt (Causal.SFABTZ.singularPastAt) and, for p < p' on the BTZ points, J^+(p') minus sing_0(M) lies in I^+(p) (Causal.SFABTZ.Iplus_of_lt). They are not chart facts alone: both use causal arc-connectedness of M (cor:massA_cac, l.1408), and Iplus_of_lt also push-up of M (cor:pushup_sing, l.1419), both stated after the definition and both resting on absolute minimality (cor:massA_causalite, l.1396). The model input is local and elementary: in a ball of E_0 centred on an axis point, the relations of the ball are E_0's global ones (le_ballOpens_iff, lt_ballOpens_iff). Non-vacuous at M = E_0 with sing_0 = axis non-empty (nonvacuous_e0). With the field line (T-ett-sfa-line-e0) this gives BTZAxioms (btzAxioms_of_line), and SingularFlatAxioms at every Hausdorff, second countable E_{>=0}-manifold iff line and massive_line (singularFlatAxioms_iff_lines; at E_0-manifolds iff line, singularFlatAxioms_iff_line_e0).

ETT.tex:1565-1573 (proof of prop:K_calcul (c)): the proof takes « a sequence p_n in J^-(p) minus {p}, increasing and converging to p » and applies lem:K_facile, which needs p in Int J^+(p_n) (the curation's finding on l.1570: unchecked). At every BTZ point of every E_{>=0}-manifold such a sequence exists, with p in Int J^+(p_n) for every n, and for each x < p it can be chosen with x in Int_{J^-(p)} J^-(p_0) (Causal.SFABTZ.singularPastAt). Consequently prop:K_calcul holds at every E_{>=0}-manifold (Causal.SFABTZ.K_calcul, (c) when M is causal) and prop:K_monotone at every causal one (Causal.SFABTZ.K_monotone), through the existing Causality.K_calcul and Causality.K_monotone, in the readings above and with push-up in place of causal plainness (OQ-16). Neither uses lem:past_BTZ (a). The proof of prop:K_monotone's fourth case (l.1626-1630, « x << p by Definition defi:causal_E0 and push-up ») is valid at M in DEC-64's form, which is the form Iplus_of_lt proves at M.

Roadmap, not the paper (the planner's [r] notes in T-ett-sfa-btz-e0). (1) « Step (a) needs no induction on chains (causal arc-connectedness plus mem_of_causalCurveOn) »: confirmed (mem_sing_zero_of_le, Jminus_subset_component). (2) Step (b), the chart transitions as tau-translations (BPrimeE0.exists_eqOn_rotE0_tauShift): not needed. Every step reads one chart into E_0 at a time, at x, at p, or at the last BTZ point q of a curve. No transition is used. (3) « Two model facts are needed in local form, in every open set of E_0 containing the relevant axis segment »: more than is needed. Balls centred on the axis suffice, and there both facts follow from one convexity lemma (le_ballOpens_iff, lt_ballOpens_iff; then le_of_axis, mem_interior_Jplus, and E0.lt_axis_iff through lt_ballSource_iff). The every-open-set forms are neither proved nor used. (4) Step (c) is confirmed as written in curve form. The last BTZ parameter is the sup of the closed set c^{-1}(sing_0(M)). The point below q comes from the first arrival at q of a curve from z to q, where z = p if p != q and z = p' otherwise (exists_below). p = q indeed forces M non-causal. (5) Step (d) has a gap in its wording. The u_n at p must lie above u_0 (for u_0 <= u_1), not only « above the chain's last point below p ». If the first step from x already reaches p, which happens when p lies on the axis of the chart at x (for instance x = (0,0), p = (1,0) in E_0), the chain's last point below p is x. A sequence above x and below u_0 then breaks monotonicity. Repair used in Lean: take u_0 on a causal curve from x to p, after the curve's last visit to x and before its first arrival at p, so u_0 != p (exists_above). Then take w below p on a curve from u_0 (exists_below) and u_0 := w. (6) Not mentioned by the planner: the first and last parameters at a point need T1. It is derived from the charts (t1Space_of_isoChartsCover).
questions: Of what is defi:causal_E0 (ETT.tex:1344-1356) a statement: only of the model E_0, as printed (« for a singular point p in sing(E_0) »), or also of the BTZ points of an E_{>=0}-manifold, as its own l.1349-1350 (« a E_{>=0}-manifold with at least one extreme BTZ white hole is not past distinguishing ») and Section 3 (l.1565-1573, l.1626-1630, l.1663-1669) use it? Reading taken: at the model it is Causal.E0.causal_E0, as before. At M it is the two global fields BTZAxioms.singularPastAt and Iplus_of_lt (DEC-64), proved here at every E_{>=0}-manifold, plus J^-(p) inside the component of sing_0(M) through p. The literal « J^-(p) is the singular half-line below p » is not read at M. It needs the line parametrised (T-ett-sfa-line-e0) and M causal. By hand, not formalized: in E_0 modulo a tau-translation, the BTZ points form a circle and J^-(p) is the whole circle, while SingularPastAt still holds (SingularFlat SCOPE already notes the circle component).

kb_proposals: Local forms of E_0's model facts for free: in a ball B(a, delta) of E_0 centred on an axis point, <=_B and <<_B are E_0's global Le, Lt (Causal.SFABTZ.le_ballOpens_iff, lt_ballOpens_iff, from E0.mem_ball_of_le_of_le and the straight segment cle_of_seg/clt_of_seg). Through a ChartIso e into E_0 the same holds on ballSource e a delta (the part of e.source over the ball), with chartImage e (ballSource e a delta) = ballOpens a delta once the ball is in e.target (le_ballSource_iff, lt_ballSource_iff). So E_0's global le_axis_iff, lt_axis_iff, le_axis_iff' apply inside a chart ball at M with no local re-proof.

Global BTZ facts at an E_{>=0}-manifold from one chart at a time (Causal.SFABTZ): run a causal curve c : [0,1] -> M (causal arc-connectedness) and take the last parameter at x / the first at q (csSup_mem / csInf_mem of the closed set Icc 0 1 ∩ c ⁻¹' {x}, T1 from the charts: t1Space_of_isoChartsCover), or the last BTZ parameter (Icc 0 1 ∩ c ⁻¹' sing_0, closed). Then CurveOn.rel at that parameter with N = ballSource gives a point of the curve over the axis just above/below, compared in E_0. No chart transitions (exists_eqOn_rotE0_tauShift) are needed; after leaving sing_0, push-up in M (Causality.PushUp.lt_of_le_of_lt / lt_of_lt_of_le, called by full name: PushUp unfolds to a ∀, kb/0010).

Every E_{>=0}-manifold (IsoChartsCoverDEC25 over massAModelCausality) is T1 and first countable from its charts: Causal.SFABTZ.t1Space_of_isoChartsCover, firstCountableTopology_of_isoChartsCover (via OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_map_nhds_eq and Filter.map's IsCountablyGenerated instance). Use them instead of carrying [T1Space M] or [FirstCountableTopology M]; e.g. Causality.K_calcul and K_monotone instantiate at every E_{>=0}-manifold (SFABTZ.K_calcul, K_monotone) with no line field.
